tagline: Cover the bill. Keep every share fair.

auth.title: Sign in to Qattah
auth.subtitle: Phone or email — enter the code and sign in
auth.phoneHint: Saudi mobiles start with 5. The default prefix is +966, and we store the full number such as +9665xxxxxxxx so WhatsApp can deliver.
auth.codeHint: Enter the code, then Sign in. No code yet? Sign in with the field empty and we will send one.
auth.name: Your name

home.empty: No groups yet. Create one and add people by phone number.

group.name: Group name
group.membersCanSubmit: Members may submit expenses or payments (admin approval required)
group.kafuHint: This person can be counted on to pay, and is included when covering the expense.
group.baseline: Amount needed to cover the cost
group.inviteHint: Add by phone or email — they do not need an account yet.
group.phoneHint: Saudi mobiles start with 5, e.g. 512345678. The default prefix is +966, and we store the full international number (+9665xxxxxxxx).
group.budgetHint: Group budget = approved payments − approved expenses. Surplus is positive; deficit is negative. Pay-from-budget uses leftover unallocated payments (FIFO), not this number.
group.depositPending: This is a normal payment and needs approval before it counts.

activity.title: Activity title
activity.createExpenseHint: Log purchases here — this is the heart of the activity.
activity.emptyExpenses: No expenses yet. Add the first one.
activity.closedHint: This activity is closed — no new expenses.

expense.title: What was it?
expense.fromBudgetHint: Draws unallocated payment surplus into this expense. Not a new contribution. Baseline is computed on the remaining amount after this draw.
expense.sealedHint: Locks the amount only — the expense is not complete. Collection and payments still work. After this, the amount cannot be changed.
expense.amountLocked: The amount is fixed and cannot be changed.

payment.title: Record a payment
payment.unallocatedHint: Optional — links the payment to an expense for collection. Every payment counts in the group budget.
payment.fromBudgetHint: Draws unallocated payment surplus into this expense. Not a new contribution. Baseline is computed on the remaining amount after this draw.
payment.pendingHint: Payments stay pending until an admin approves them. After approval they cannot be edited.
payment.approveConfirm: Approve this payment? You will not be able to edit it afterward.
payment.label: Method name
payment.labelHint: A name you’ll recognize, like STC Pay wallet or Al Rajhi personal
payment.addField: Add another detail to this method
payment.ibanHint: IBAN and the account holder’s name
payment.qrHint: A photo of the transfer QR (STC Pay or similar)
payment.linkHint: A payment link if you have one
payment.methodsIntro: Save how people pay you. Name it, pick a type, then add more details later.
payment.tapToOpen: Tap to add IBAN, QR, or a link
payment.guestHint: Record a payment for someone who joined once — they are not added as a member and do not owe the group.
payment.anonymousHint: The payment is recorded on the shared user +000000000000, who is not a member of any group.

report.colBaseline: Amount needed to cover the cost

errors.invalid_identifier: Enter a valid phone or email
errors.too_many_otp: You have used today’s 3 codes. Enter the last code we sent.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts — request a new code
errors.no_challenge: No code yet — tap Sign in and we will send one
errors.no_recipients: No recipients for the selected channels
errors.allocate_required: Link the payment to an expense to pay from the budget
errors.sealed: The amount is fixed and cannot change
errors.already_approved: This payment is approved and cannot be edited or deleted
errors.has_sealed_expense: This activity has an expense with a fixed amount and cannot be deleted
errors.not_member: Choose a member of this group
errors.anonymous_not_allowed: The anonymous account cannot be added as a member

common.confirmDelete: Delete this? This cannot be undone.
